headline: Eco-requirements will raise fuel prices by 15-17 euro cents/litre next year
summary: Bulgaria and five other EU member states plan to sign a joint declaration in Sofia asking the European Commission to review green transport rules. The eco-requirements are said to raise fuel prices by 15-17 euro cents per litre next year.
why: EU emissions and transport regulation influences fuel costs for consumers, transport companies and refiners across member states.
